name: mocha-config-unused
description: Made-up project for js-prueffactory tests: Mocha configs under test/config built through a shared helper whose require paths are relative to the package root, setup files that import a helper only they use, mocha-multi-reporters as the reporter and c8 used only in a CI shell script. src/unused.js and the dependency is-odd are really unused, and must still be reported.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
